mentions.text:
@Hamish_Low5 "But surely if you have a mix of ASML and domestic tools you use the ASML ones for the critical layer?"

Let's say I have to set up a 10k WPM 7nm line
I have a bunch of older ASML machines for less critical nodes, as they are not export controls, but I don't have a 1980i/2000i for the most critical layer
Now, Yuliangsheng has machines that can pattern the most critical layers, but their throughput is lower
So what would u do in this scenario??
Use the more productive ASML machines for the less critical layers, and use the Yuliangsheng machines for the most critical layer
this is the only way u can expand or set up new 7nm/5nm lines in the most efficient manner
